description: Optional dialogue-memory vocabulary. These predicates are a domain package, not universal knowledge or immutable axioms.

predicates.name: likes
predicates.meaning: use likes(Person, Thing) with polarity=positive for like/love and polarity=negative for dislike/hate/cannot stand/do not like; never invent or emit an antonym predicate such as dislikes

predicates.name: lives_in
predicates.meaning: a person lives in a place

predicates.name: works_at
predicates.meaning: a person works at an organization

predicates.name: studies_at
predicates.meaning: a person studies at an organization

predicates.name: birth_year
predicates.meaning: a person has a stated year of birth

predicates.name: email
predicates.meaning: an entity has a stated email address atom

predicates.name: interested_in
predicates.meaning: an agent is interested in an entity or activity

predicates.name: previous_project
predicates.meaning: a person previously participated in a project

predicates.name: role_before_semester
predicates.meaning: person, organization, role, and boundary semester

predicates.name: project_role_at
predicates.meaning: person, organization, project, and project role

predicates.name: worked_with_technology
predicates.meaning: a person has worked with a technology
